name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — Advanced — Curse of Clytaemnestra

system.description: Created by the Tremere elder Carna to destroy the lovers she believes have betrayed her, this ritual rapidly ages a male target's physical form until it decays to nothing. The caster must possess a personal possession of the target as well as some of his blood, and the casting takes a full day. The target resists with Stamina and Fortitude against a difficulty set by the number of blood traits the caster expended casting it; surviving requires an exceptional resistance, and even a survivor is left crippled, if only temporarily. The ritual only affects men, and invariably costs the caster some of her own Humanity or Path rating to cast.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Carna's own creation)
system.bloodCost: Caster's choice (determines difficulty); costs the caster Humanity/Path
